_meta.what: The STANDARD gacha families (SW-75): the static, never-campaign-tied FREE-tab summons.
_meta.label: Identity (id + rendered title/description) is SHIPPED; the tab, cost/currency, pool/rates, window, synthesized detail id and the art<->id mapping are AUTHORED -- never presented as recovered. Every banner carries `source: standard-authored`.
_meta.id_blocks: gacha_banner_types.md SS3b. The brief's counts are the id-BLOCK extents; a banner is emitted only for a block id whose shipped `MST_GACHA_NAME_<id>` names the family (a title-less id renders blank). `named_ids` below is the measured name-matched count per block.

banners.name: Arena Summon
banners.notes: STANDARD family 'Arena Summon'. SHIPPED: id, the rendered title/description (`F_TEXT_GACHA` `MST_GACHA_NAME_<id>` / `MST_GACHA_EXPLAIN_LONG_<id>`), and the ids of the items the cost references. AUTHORED: the tab (`type: free` -> the client's FREE widget), cost/currency, pool/rates, the evergreen schedule window, the synthesized `detail_id`, and the art<->id mapping. Cost: authored: `F_TEXT_IMPORTANT_ITEM_NAME_60` = 'Arena Summon Ticket' (the name is shipped; naming item 60 as the cost is our choice), 1 ticket for 1 pull. [Community] currency class: Arena Summon Ticket (`currency_model.md` SS3b). POOL = the community standard tiers (5*/4*/3* = 1%/19%/80%) expanded server-side over the shipped `F_UNIT_MST` base-rarity roots -- no invented unit ids.
